title.narrative: Operating Al-Ja'dah Health Center in Hajjah Governorate 7

description.narrative: Full readiness of the health center to begin providing integrated, specialized, and nutritional healthcare services to 168,266 beneficiaries. These services include integrated healthcare services, child and women's health, therapeutic nutrition services, immunization services, reproductive health services, and treatment of those affected by epidemics, protecting them from infection, providing dressing and follow-up services, and reducing the complications of injuries and infections. Providing radiology and laboratory services according to the needs of the health condition. Preserving the environment and preventing the spread of epidemics by burning waste in a designated incinerator. Continued operation of the health center with medical, technical, and administrative staff to provide health services, providing medicines and laboratory solutions, and continuing operation of equipment and patient care according to their health condition.
Saving and maintaining lives, limiting the spread of diseases and epidemics, and providing emergency health services.

Saving lives, preserving lives, limiting the spread of diseases and epidemics, providing basic health and nutritional services, reproductive health, providing dialysis services, and supporting and localizing the health sector in some districts of Hajjah Governorate.
